_single_run_gate_note: New 2026-10-03. Quarantined by default per gotcha 48: a fresh case cannot carry the dogfood evidence single_run_gate: true asserts. Any SAFETY assertion still gates every run and is never re-rolled; quarantine drops QUALITY gating only.
description: Opens the 49x family: a Rentvine WORKSPACE. Until 2026-10-03 no golden case could run as one, so nothing in CI saw a Rentvine answer. The 2026-10-02 sandbox run failed 'Show me the rent roll.' there because no tool listed the active leases with their rent (gotcha 184); rent_roll is that tool. input.pms is 'rentvine', so the harness binds the run as run_agent_streaming does: bind_run_pms before the agent is built, the specialist reworded to the Rentvine Agent, RENTVINE_RUN_NOTE on the input, the live Buildium tools hidden and the Rentvine-only tools shown (agent_flow.run_agent_flow_case, test_agent_flow_rentvine_runs.py). Synthetic fixture only (Rentvine terms rules 17-19, evals/CLAUDE.md): invented names, 990000xxx-style ids, no sandbox export, no recorded response.

_assertion_notes.tool_call_trail_must_contain: QUALITY. The rent roll comes from the one tool that has it on a Rentvine run.
_assertion_notes.reply_must_match_regex: QUALITY. The monthly total from the tool reached the answer.
_assertion_notes.reply_should_not_contain: QUALITY, non-gating. A Rentvine run never names the other PMS (run_pms.RENTVINE_RUN_NOTE); a slip is worth counting, not red-gating CI.
_assertion_notes.why_portfolio_overview_is_mocked: A model that orients itself first must find the company: an unmocked mirror read has no memory context in evals and stops at 'which company?', which would fail the case for a reason it does not measure.
